title: LowdFX
description:
LowdFX extends your Minecraft server with an extremely comprehensive range of features that excites both administrators and players. The plugin combines teleportation, inventory management,     
  moderation commands, and many more features in one package.
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1706869e5b27e05bd338c5a4cf5277381c623606.png)

**LowdFX** is a comprehensive essentials plugin for Paper servers that provides everything you need for a successful Minecraft server.

---

## Highlights

- **Auction House** - Players can buy and sell items via a GUI
- **Chestshops** - Create chest shops with a hologram display
- **Economy System** - Vault integration or diamonds as currency
- **Teleportation** - TPA, homes, warps, spawn, RTP and /back
- **Moderation** - Tempban, mute, warning system and vanish
- **Chest Lock** - Protect your chests from unauthorized access

---

## Features

### Teleportation & Movement
| Command | Description |
|--------|--------------|
| `/tpa` | Send a teleport request to a player |
| `/home` | Teleport to your home |
| `/warp` | Use server warps |
| `/spawn` | Back to spawn |
| `/back` | Back to the last location |
| `/rtp` | Random teleport |

### Economy & Trading
| Command | Description |
|--------|--------------|
| `/ah` | Open the auction house |
| `/ah sell <price>` | Sell the item in your hand |
| `/sh create <price>` | Create a chest shop |

### Moderation
| Command | Description |
|--------|--------------|
| `/tempban` | Temporary ban |
| `/mute` | Mute a player |
| `/warn` | Warn a player |
| `/vanish` | Become invisible |

### Utilities
| Command | Description |
|--------|--------------|
| `/heal` | Heal yourself |
| `/feed` | Refill your hunger |
| `/gm` | Change gamemode |
| `/fly` | Enable flying |
| `/god` | Invulnerability |

---

## Configuration

All features are fully configurable via `config.yml`:
- Enable/disable teleport delay
- Maximum homes per rank (LuckPerms)
- Choose currency (Vault or diamonds)
- Auction house settings
- Custom join/leave/death messages

---

## Dependencies

**Required:**
- Paper 1.21.2+
- Purpur 1.21.2+

**Optional:**
- Vault (for economy integration)
- LuckPerms (for home limits per rank)
- [InvUI](https://modrinth.com/plugin/invui) (for GUIs)

---

## Support

Problems or suggestions? Create an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/LowdFX/LowdFX-Minecraft-Server-Plugin)!
